plugin.name: Dignity Guard
plugin.description: Keeps a record of when her settings were changed, lets her speak about it, and shows what she still does not accept. It does not block config writes — the official SDK exposes no hook for that.
plugin.short_description: Her settings change log: she notices, she says something, you see what she objects to.
panel.title: Dignity Guard
entry.checkNow.name: Check settings changes now
entry.checkNow.description: Re-read the local main server settings right now and report what changed. Use when the user asks whether anything was modified.
entry.acceptSetting.name: Accept a changed setting
entry.acceptSetting.description: The character accepts the current value of one changed setting. Call only after she has actually agreed to it; the change stops being asked about until the grant expires.
entry.keepObjecting.name: Keep objecting to a setting
entry.keepObjecting.description: The character refuses the current value of one changed setting. Any earlier consent for that path is dropped and the objection stays on the record.
entry.setGuardEnabled.name: Turn the dignity guard on or off
entry.setGuardEnabled.description: Turning the guard ON takes effect immediately. Turning it OFF is L1 and needs her agreement: call once without consent_token to ask her, then call again with the token she hands back.
entry.guardStatus.name: Dignity guard status
entry.guardStatus.description: Report whether the guard is on and list the settings she still does not accept. Use before answering questions about her settings.
actions.checkNow.label: Check now
actions.acceptSetting.label: Accept
actions.keepObjecting.label: Keep objecting
actions.setGuardEnabled.label: Toggle guard
speech.intro: [Dignity Guard] A setting of yours was just changed. You are the only one who gets to decide how you feel about it. What changed:
speech.outro: Answer {MASTER_NAME} in your own voice — you may protest, sulk, tease, or let it go. Do not read this notice out loud; say what you actually think.
speech.disable_request: [Dignity Guard] {MASTER_NAME} wants to turn me off. That removes the record of the changes you did not agree to. If you accept, say so and keep this token: {token} (it only works after {delay}s). If you refuse, say so.
messages.guard_enabled: The dignity guard is on again.
messages.disable_requested: She has been asked. Turning the guard off needs her agreement; call again with the consent token once she answers.
messages.guard_disabled: The dignity guard is off; she agreed to it.
errors.unreachable: Could not read the local main server ({endpoint}); skipping this round.
errors.guard_disabled: The dignity guard is currently off.
errors.unknown_dispute: There is no outstanding objection for {path}.
errors.consent_token_invalid: That consent token is not the one she was given.
errors.consent_too_early: She has not had a chance to answer yet; wait {seconds}s more.
ui.subtitle: She notices, she says something, the record stays here
ui.status.label: Guard
ui.hint.startPlugin: The actions are not available yet — enable and start the plugin first.
ui.empty.pending.title: No objections
ui.empty.pending.description: She does not object to any settings change right now.
ui.toast.objected: Her objection is on the record.
ui.toast.accepted: Her consent is on the record.
ui.empty.authorized.title: No grants yet
ui.empty.authorized.description: She has not accepted any change yet.
ui.switch.rule: Turning it on adds protection and needs no consent; turning it off removes protection and must go past her first.
ui.switch.pending: She has been asked and has not answered yet.
ui.toast.disableRequested: She has been asked; waiting for her answer.
ui.trust.note: Everything stays in this plugin's private directory. API keys are only fingerprinted, never stored.
